**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Recognize Setext headings before assembling paragraphs**

For Markdown using Setext headings, `Title\n=====` is parsed as a paragraph containing `Title =====`, while `Title\n-----` becomes a paragraph followed by a horizontal rule instead of an `h2`. Neither input triggers the unestimated-content fallback, so the estimator confidently measures headings using the smaller paragraph style. Long headings can consequently receive a recommended height that clips their rendered text. Recognize these underline forms as heading blocks, or explicitly leave them unestimated.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

<!-- codex-code-review-finding:v1 -->

causal_evidence: Commit 57b2308b46368d3c1b97100ebe0df4f81088dd59 adds sizing.py. Executing its parser reproduces both reported cases: Title\n===== becomes [('p', 'Title =====')]; Title\n----- becomes [('p', 'Title'), ('hr', '')].
At supplied HEAD 818224b6f92fa7bcd32c9152986e19844d9f83a1, sizing.py:373 uses MarkdownIt('commonmark'); lines 440–446 preserve heading tags.
Commit 818224b6f92fa7bcd32c9152986e19844d9f83a1 adds the passing Setext regression test at tests/unit/test_layout_sizing.py:230.
evidences: Worktree HEAD matches head_before and head_after: 818224b6f92fa7bcd32c9152986e19844d9f83a1.
tests/unit/test_layout_sizing.py:230–234 verifies that Setext underlines produce h1 and h2 blocks.
Independent execution at HEAD confirmed identical blocks and SizingEstimate results for Setext and equivalent ATX headings, using both short titles and 390-character headings.
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -s -p no:cacheprovider tests/unit/test_layout_sizing.py: 37 passed.
payload.headline: Setext finding already addressed at the supplied HEAD
payload.before: The initial PR implementation interpreted Setext headings as paragraphs or a paragraph followed by a horizontal rule.
payload.after: The current CommonMark parser recognizes both underline forms and applies the corresponding heading styles.
payload.motivation: The historical defect is reproducible, but it is absent from the revision being judged. No additional code change is needed.
payload.reply: Already addressed in 818224b6f92fa7bcd32c9152986e19844d9f83a1. Both Setext forms produce heading blocks and match equivalent ATX height estimates, including long headings. The sizing test module passes all 37 tests.
